recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Bank of America VP from NJ killed in Times Square knife rampage
recentItems.description:

Investigators say the suspect stabbed a 68-year-old man before targeting Erin Piacenti, a Chester resident and Bank of America vice president. The suspect, Pamela Cisneros, was later confronted by NYPD officers, threatened police, and was fatally shot.

recentItems.title: Fake Amazon home invasion mastermind sentenced while on the run
recentItems.description:
A Connecticut man convicted in a violent 2022 home invasion was sentenced even though he remains on the run. Prosecutors said the suspects posed as Amazon delivery workers before forcing their way into a Milford home, beating and binding the victim, and stealing more than $50,000 in jewelry and watches. A judge sentenced Shane Gordon to 45 years, suspended after 23 years served, followed by five years of probation.

recentItems.title: DHS launches voter fraud blitz in NY and Connecticut
recentItems.description:
The Department of Homeland Security has launched what it calls a coordinated criminal voter fraud investigation in New York, Connecticut and several other states. Election officials in Connecticut say they were not contacted about any investigation and remain unclear on the operation’s scope. DHS says the effort could lead to criminal charges and will continue through mid-October.

recentItems.title: Hochul, Mamdani demand $87M as feds withhold counterterrorism funds
recentItems.description:
